11 notes. `agtk memory show <name>` opens one and records a hit; add `--no-hit` for a read that is not consulting the store.

## changed-projects-select-all-regex  (gotcha, verified)
changed-projects selects every project only for ci-[a-z]+.yml, actions/ and .lydite/; go.work, dependabot.yml, other workflows and root files select none, so build and test are skipped.

- .github/actions/changed-projects/action.yml

## dependabot-auto-merge-secrets-named-not-inherited  (gotcha, verified)
gt reusable workflows get secrets by name, not secrets: inherit, because gt lives under a different owner and inherit silently drops them.

- .github/workflows/dependabot-auto-merge.yml

## dependabot-gomod-entry-per-project  (gotcha, verified)
dependabot.yml has one gomod entry per module and is generated from .gt-repo.yaml, so a new source/<project> gets no Go updates until the entry is added there and gt repo sync is run.

- .github/dependabot.yml
- .gt-repo.yaml

## gt-token-cannot-touch-workflows  (gotcha, verified)
GITHUB_TOKEN cannot modify .github/workflows/**, so gt-sync never repairs workflow drift and Dependabot github-actions bumps never auto-merge.

- .github/workflows/gt-sync.yml
- .github/workflows/dependabot-auto-merge.yml

## lydite-clearance-is-separate-workflow  (rationale, verified)
gt-lydite-clearance.yml is its own issue_comment workflow because comment-triggered runs use the default branch's workflow files, so it cannot be tested from a PR.

- .github/workflows/gt-lydite-clearance.yml

## lydite-job-has-no-skip-guard  (rationale, verified)
The lydite job in ci-orchestration.yml runs on !cancelled() with no skip guard and lydite-baseline is absent from ci-gate needs, both on purpose.

- .github/workflows/ci-orchestration.yml

## preflight-skip-build-skips-test  (gotcha, verified)
test needs build, so a preflight that sets only run-build=false silently skips test too; only run-test=false skips independently.

- .github/workflows/ci-orchestration.yml
- .github/workflows/ci-preflight.yml

## release-prerelease-tags-always-fail  (gotcha, verified)
A pre-release tag like source/x/v1.0.0-rc.1 passes release.yml's tag regex but verify-sibling-deps rejects it, after the tag is already pushed.

- .github/workflows/release.yml
- .github/actions/verify-sibling-deps/action.yml

## release-tag-exists-before-validation  (gotcha, verified)
release.yml is triggered by the tag push, so the tag already exists when its validation fails, and re-running checks out the tagged commit so missing release notes cannot be fixed.

- .github/workflows/release.yml

## release-v2-tags-fail-announce  (gotcha, verified)
release.yml builds the module path without a /vN suffix, so a correctly-pathed v2+ module fails the announce job's proxy check.

- .github/workflows/release.yml
- .github/actions/verify-sibling-deps/action.yml

## verify-sibling-deps-tag-check-unauthenticated  (gotcha, verified)
verify-sibling-deps checks sibling tags with an unauthenticated git ls-remote and treats any failure as 'no tag', so a private repo fails every sibling require.

- .github/actions/verify-sibling-deps/action.yml
